verdict.rationale: llama.cpp provides direct `-hf` flags for both CLI and server modes to pull models straight from Hugging Face repos (e.g. ggml-org/Qwen3.5-0.8B-GGUF), confirmed by first-party GitHub docs and community reports of successfully running downloaded GGUF models. missing for 10: no independent hands-on report specifically testing the -hf download flow (community evidence covers running models but not the HF download shortcut itself).
